exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 7337 singleton births in breech presentation between 1991 and 2014
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of inflammatory bowel disease and overall gastrointestinal morbidity in offspring delivered in breech presentation.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of inflammatory bowel disease and overall gastrointestinal morbidity in offspring delivered in breech presentation.
